component.name: WF-Studio for Linux
component.summary: Unofficial Linux launcher for Samsung Galaxy Watch Face Studio

description.p: Runs Samsung's official Galaxy Watch Face Studio natively on Linux, without Wine. You download the official Windows release from Samsung's website yourself; the app verifies Samsung's digital signature and runs its cross-platform parts on a native Linux Electron runtime together with native Android build tools and a JDK.
This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Samsung. Watch Face Studio is proprietary software of Samsung Electronics and is not included in this package.
